data.name: Herra
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Herra was the goddess of the earth, agriculture, and the harvest. She was also known as the protector of women and children. Herra's name comes from the Greek word 'heros,' meaning 'lord' or 'master,' reflecting her role as a goddess and protector.

seo.description_paragraph: Herra, also known as Hera or Heraea, is a powerful Greek goddess revered for her protection of women, children, and agriculture. Derived from the Greek word 'heros,' meaning 'lord' or 'master,' Herra's name reflects her role as a goddess and protector. In Greek mythology, Herra was the wife of Zeus, the king of the gods, and was known as the queen of the heavens. She was the goddess of the earth, agriculture, and the harvest, and her worship spread throughout Greece, Asia Minor, and Rome.
